build: Extracted the submission ZIP in a clean temporary directory. The sole entry point main.tex is byte-identical to the registered source. latexmk completed with no final-log warnings or overfull boxes.
layout: Rendered all 13 pages with Poppler at 90 dpi and visually inspected all pages in contact sheets.

blind_reader.reviewer: Separate ChatGPT reviewer with no inherited conversation and instructed to read only the compiled PDF. Internal review.
blind_reader.supplied_context: Compiled PDF and five editorial questions plus a request to audit principal-orbit transfer and arithmetic specialization.
blind_reader.new_results: Split classification, active split rank one without rational points, field descent, real-closed classifications, long-root obstruction, and compact and toral refinements.
blind_reader.mechanism: Closed principal orbits give an adjoint covariant or a descended normalizer map. Invariant denominators preserve purity. Arithmetic specialization preserves infinitely many marked orders.
blind_reader.hardest_step: Uniform specialization of the first polynomial recurrence coefficient (Section 4), with the rational map and denominator transfer as the geometric bottleneck (Section 3).
blind_reader.limitations: Unresolved compact exceptional products and general anisotropic nonsplit spaces. The witness exists over the base field, without a general explicit expression for the specialized pair.
blind_reader.verification_obstacles: The exceptional moment identities and finite-trace separation use the deposited complex manuscript. Specify scalar exclusions in the Hilbert specialization, identify long roots in a geometric simple system, and justify infinitude in the prime progressions.
blind_reader.revisions: Explicit finite avoidance conditions including the scalar factor, geometric simple-root wording, Dirichlet's theorem for the exceptional subsequences, and a direct adjoint moment calculation.
blind_reader.recheck: The PDF-only reviewer confirmed the scalar-factor and degree-zero exclusion, geometric root wording, exceptional infinitude, and direct adjoint calculation. The reviewer also checked the odd-order-center extension and quaternion example and reported no new substantive defect.

mathematical_audit: Principal open: compact conjugation gives closed maximal-dimensional orbits in the principal Luna stratum. Stabilizer conjugacy and self-normalization give Galois descent of the normalizer map without a ground-field point.
Invariant denominator: finite coefficient module gives a denominator ideal compatible with flat base change. A compact square establishes nonzero radial powers in the full marked product sequence.

Arithmetic: verified the line reduction, p-adic embeddings near poles, integral reciprocal under the prime-degree change of variable, coprimality argument, finite exceptions under Hilbert specialization, and backward propagation.
Recurrence: holonomic direct-image finiteness over the parameter field, bounded denominators in the twisted primitive, and descent from a finite point field by a basis coefficient.
bounded_checks: Replayed the complex companion checker, including exact exceptional invariants, direct moment and prime-coefficient checks, radial identities, and negative controls.
Checked the angular constant-term and adjoint beta formulas by independent finite sums over the rationals at orders 1 through 16.
open_mathematics: The binary octahedral and binary icosahedral compact products with a split Laurent factor.
General anisotropic nonsplit homogeneous spaces over their ground fields.
Disconnected nonsplit cases outside the stated split and toral criteria.
